description: This file is a plugin for FullCalendar v2.2.7 that integrates Google Calendar data, providing functions to normalize sources, fetch events via Google Calendar API, and process event data including categorization based on hashtags.

methods.name: transformOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns the options object for fetching Google Calendar events, including URL, data parameters, and success callback that processes event data.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting by invoking error callbacks and logging to console.

methods.name: injectQsComponent
methods.description: Inserts a query string component into a URL before the fragment identifier.
